title: Add AisleConfig Domain Types
description: Create the public `AisleConfig`, `AisleSection`, and `AisleItem` types and expose the `aisle(for:)` lookup API surface expected by the package.
acceptance_criteria: `AisleConfig.swift` defines all public aisle config value types with `Sendable` and `Equatable` conformance.
The public API shape matches the spec exactly, including the lookup method signature.

handoff_summary.completed: Created `Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/AisleConfig.swift` with public `AisleConfig`, `AisleSection`, and `AisleItem` value types, each conforming to `Sendable` and `Equatable`. `AisleConfig` exposes `init(sections:)` with a default empty array and a public `aisle(for ingredient: String) -> AisleSection?` lookup method.
handoff_summary.risks: Package-level `swift build` could not be executed in this sandbox because SwiftPM manifest evaluation is blocked by sandbox restrictions. Verification was limited to `swiftc -typecheck Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/AisleConfig.swift` with a writable module cache override.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Downstream beads `B-30f7ab84` and `B-cd3c52af` are expected to edit the same file family (`AisleConfig.swift` and parser companion) to add parsing and case-insensitive alias lookup behavior.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `canonical` plus `aliases` on `AisleItem` to match the aisle-file token model described in the spec beads. Implemented the lookup on `AisleConfig` returning the first matching section in declaration order, with exact string matching for now so later lookup-specific work can extend behavior without changing the public API shape.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Did not run any test suite per developer guardrails. Performed a syntax/type check only: `CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/private/tmp/swift-module-cache swiftc -typecheck Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/AisleConfig.swift`.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Lookup behavior is currently exact-match only; the separate alias-lookup bead is still responsible for the spec's case-insensitive matching rules.

conflict_risks: Downstream beads `B-30f7ab84` and `B-cd3c52af` are expected to edit the same file family (`AisleConfig.swift` and parser companion) to add parsing and case-insensitive alias lookup behavior.
